title: Page 56
transc:
Ft Monroe April 11th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Bender I require Federal promise shelter tents at
once to fill requisition of Nankin also large amount
of water whig drawing not over pony feet pedlar
will specify Peru possible Zodiac will you secure plague
ferry boats and at least pledge measles like city
of Norwich or George Leary Webster Her man Biggs
lent paradise and Vincent Laura here we go again
Geo. D Sheldon


Ft. Monroe April 11th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
from Newport News April flag for Burton growl zodiac princess
Demarivault torch French man of war Tesiphone called on me
this morning Zebra the French man of war Grenade and 
plug whimper are also in the Roads unity pilgrim D.
expects another whimper in a few days unity He will
be ready to go up Bergen with plunge whimper day
after whelp zodiac He asks if he is at liberty
to pass up when he is ready & I have
replied that he can go at the time he mentioned
zebra He thinks that no white to me is Tarquin
torch quantity of tobacco moved star but would have no
objection to making it unity I supposed this to be
called for by the convention sugar but would not expect
it as at present advised Zodiac please instruct me if
this tablet of tobacco is to go on now star
